Notes_and_Tips: Eat meals on time to avoid migraine triggers linked to hunger.
For sweet cravings under stress, start with protein and wait 10 minutes.
Keep spices balanced; extremely spicy or oily meals may trigger migraines.
Dance is good cardio; support it with regular meals and hydration.
Focus on visible body changes and confidence rather than quick weight drops.
